ValidationRule.description: R-SS1: the service and cohort are the program's, at least one weekday, every 1 to 52 weeks, each session ends after it starts, the end date is not before the start date. Holds with automation off.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( Service__r.Program__c <> Program__c, AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Cohort__c)), Cohort__r.Program__c <> Program__c), ISBLANK(Weekdays__c), ISBLANK(Every_N_Weeks__c), Every_N_Weeks__c < 1, Every_N_Weeks__c > 52, AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Start_Time__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(End_Time__c)), End_Time__c <= Start_Time__c ), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(End_Date__c)), End_Date__c < Start_Date__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Check the schedule: choose a service and cohort of this program, pick at least one day, repeat every 1 to 52 weeks, end each session after it starts, and keep the end date on or after the start date.
